comments.text:
I understand where you're coming from, but think about how my day to day has evolved. 

My job now is to tinker with all the new tools that come out and share with you guys what I'm learning. 

I genuinely think that I've tested over 200 AI tools. 

The reason why you only see a few on my channel is because I'm trying to show you guys the core orchestrators that you should invest time in and learn at a deep level. 

A lot of the AI tools that I've tested have been APIs that I've just connected to something like n8n or Claude Code. 

An AI tool doesn't necessarily mean it's an entire AI agent or agent harness. 

Hopefully that makes sense. I appreciate your comment and I appreciate the kind words.
